name: vibe-quiz
description: Keeps you in the loop on AI-assisted work: short multiple-choice quizzes about what was just built and why, with configurable depth and frequency.

trigger.title: Quiz trigger
trigger.description: When quizzes start automatically. 'manual' means only when you run /vibe-quiz:quiz.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: For 'commits' or 'turns': quiz every N commits or every N Claude replies.

questions_per_quiz.title: Questions per quiz
questions_per_quiz.description: How many multiple-choice questions each quiz asks.

depth.title: Question depth
depth.description: recall = what was done, understand = why, apply = consequences, challenge = critique and alternatives.

adaptive.title: Adaptive depth
adaptive.description: Go easier after misses and deeper after correct streaks.

focus.title: Question focus
focus.description: Ask about design decisions, about the implementation itself, or both.

on_wrong.title: On a wrong answer
on_wrong.description: explain = show the answer and why; explain_and_retry = also re-test the concept later; log_only = just record it for /vibe-quiz:stats.
